items.text: Among occupied residential addresses in the county with at least one fuel-burning appliance, what is the prevalence of a working carbon monoxide alarm this winter, and is it lower in privately rented than in owner-occupied homes?
items.population: Occupied residential addresses on the county property roll with at least one fuel-burning appliance
items.outcome: Working carbon monoxide alarm: present, correctly sited, sounds when the test button is pressed

items.text: Among households that report owning a carbon monoxide alarm, what proportion have one that sounds when tested?
items.population: Responding households that report owning a carbon monoxide alarm
items.outcome: Agreement between reported and working alarm

finer: Feasible within 18,000 and one winter; interesting to the board and fire service; novel locally; ethical with verbal consent at the door and a fitted alarm offered where none works; relevant because it decides where the giveaway goes.
summary: One prevalence and comparison question, one measurement question.
